label: KIAA1549::BRAF

sections.text: KIAA1549 encodes a protein implicated in nervous-system development.
BRAF encodes a RAF-family serine/threonine kinase in the MAPK pathway.

The rearrangement removes BRAF amino-terminal autoinhibitory regions while retaining its kinase, producing constitutive MAPK signaling. KIAA1549::BRAF commonly results from a tandem duplication at 7q34 and is recurrent in pilocytic astrocytoma; it also occurs in diffuse leptomeningeal glioneuronal tumor.

Tovorafenib is US-approved for relapsed or refractory pediatric low-grade glioma with a BRAF fusion or rearrangement from age 6 months. BRAF V600-selective inhibitor activity cannot be assumed for these dimeric fusions, which can show paradoxical MAPK activation.
